title: Session count/turns fields must accumulate, not reset
description: When multiple sessions run concurrently or a new session writes WAI-State.json, counters like meta.total_sessions and analytics.sessions.total_turns must be additive (read-then-increment), not set to a fixed value. Prevents count resets from concurrent writes.
_v1_type_code: Session count/turns fields must accumulate, not reset
